title: VTC Community — Theme — Show — payload
description: An empty request: the community has one theme. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Community — Theme — Show — response payload

stylesheet.description: The stored theme stylesheet, in the theme profile of vtc/community/theme/update/0.1. The empty string when the community has none.

updatedAt.description: When the stylesheet was last replaced. Absent when the community never set one.
